goal: Allow functions to return structured error codes and multiple messages or warnings instead of ad-hoc tuples
Enable callers to distinguish recoverable errors from fatal failures during initialization and wallet loading
agreement: Substantive support across multiple iterations (hernanmarino, stickies-v, sedited, laanwj, achow101)
Concept support for cleaner wallet code and chained error handling (arejula27, polespinasa)
Nonblocking objection: adds unnecessary complexity when simpler alternatives could suffice (maflcko)
Nonblocking objection: chainstate loading does not motivate multi-message support over util::Expected (hodlinator)
Several reviewers suggested restarting in a fresh PR to reset review fatigue (maflcko, sedited, polespinasa)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it provides foundational error-handling infrastructure used across multiple subsystems
Directly unblocks wallet loading refactoring (#25722) and kernel fatal-error status handling (#29700)
Eliminates ad-hoc return tuples and output parameters for complex initialization failure handling
